summary: Nuxt page component `m-feature` for the mobile route `m-lang-feature` (layout `m/default`). `asyncData` calls the Nuxt `redirect` to `m-lang-main` unconditionally and also loads the feature list via the home content API (module 1164) `getFeature` (`/getContentList`, channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.FEATURE`) with `sLangKey: store.state.lang`, exposing it as `featureList`; `created` sets `activeFeature` to the first entry. It renders the mobile `pageTab` (nav-num 6), a `m-feature__title` with the i18n `nav4Label`, and a vue-awesome-swiper `swiper` (ref `featureSwiper`, centered `auto` slides with `.swiper-pagination` / `.swiper-button-next/prev`) of `m-feature__slide` banners (`bannerInner`), whose `slideChange` handler sets `activeFeature` from `realIndex`; the active feature's title and HTML content (`sContent` or `summary`) are shown in `m-feature__info`. `head()` builds the title from i18n `nav4` + `seoTitlePrefix`, and `handleNavigatorUpload` tracks the `m-features_next` button via `$trackButton`.

exports.default: the `m-feature` mobile game-features page Vue component (route m-lang-feature, compiled with vue-loader normalizer)
